CommunityApplications.Profile: MultiVibe Host packages the auditable MultiVibe Core, its private provider agent and a managed Ollama runtime as one security-bounded container for Linux amd64 systems with a supported NVIDIA GPU. The native Windows amd64 Host is distributed separately as a verified ZIP and is not this Unraid container. The application is currently beta; state and model storage remain local and provider sharing stays disabled until the operator explicitly enables it.
